pageSubtitle: Founded in 1965, providing free comprehensive education, boarding, and character building to students.
historyP1: Established in 1965 in the rural heartland of Yavatmal district, our ashram school began with a noble mission: to provide every child from V.J.N.T., tribal, and economically challenged families access to top-tier schooling, nutritious meals, and holistic care completely free of cost.
historyP2: Over the decades, the institution has expanded from a modest primary setup into three distinct educational institutions spanning Class 1 to Class 12 Junior College in Science, Commerce, and Arts streams, shaping thousands of successful professionals, teachers, and defense personnel.
visionDesc: To empower every rural and disadvantaged child through value-based, digitally enabled, and scientifically grounded education that fosters self-reliance and nation-building.
missionDesc: Deliver free, quality education, hygienic residential care, competitive examination mentorship, sports facilities, and holistic skill development without discrimination.
hostelDesc: Free boarding and lodging for tribal & rural students
primarySummary: Class 1 to 4 - Joyful learning, continuous grade-based assessment, and child-friendly environment.
secondarySummary: Class 5 to 10 - State Board curriculum, Class 5 & 8 Scholarship exam coaching, and SSC Board preparation.
highSchoolSummary: Class 11 & 12 - Science, Commerce, and Arts streams, HSC Board preparation, and competitive exam guidance.
principalDeskSubtitle: Guiding our students with vision, discipline, and values towards a brighter tomorrow
smcSubtitle: Government statutory governing body for school administration
principalQuote: Education is not just about books; it is the foundation of character, confidence, and nation-building.
